## CLI summary

Binary `fidryn`. Subcommands: `fmt`, `check`, `run`, `explore`, `explain`, `verify`, `diff`, `render`, `file`, `ui`.
`--valid-at` / `--known-at` are RFC 3339. `run` never invents completions.

## Outcomes summary

Six kinds: determinate, contingent, suspended, normConflict, outsideCompetence, inconsistent.
Read `modelBoundary` before treating determinate as the answer.

## Examples summary

Fixtures under `examples/`. Start: `fidryn check examples/trust/bryan-revocable-trust.fr`.
Full catalog: docs/examples.md (do not replace with stubs).
